milestones.title: Foundation: dashboard, navigation, JSON import, assets
milestones.summary: Turn the research-only window into a sectioned desktop suite: a dashboard that opens every calculator, one shared save/state model, JSON import/export, the upstream asset pipeline and the per-section verification harness.
ui: Dashboard replaces the three-tab shell as the landing page: searchable card grid grouped by General, W2-W7 and Tools, with the same titles, icons, world badges and one-line descriptions as upstream index.html.
Each card opens a section route with a shared header: back to dashboard, section title, world badge, save status and an import button.
Section pages keep their upstream tab strip; the app shell only owns the window chrome and status bar.
Import dialog accepts a file, a paste or drag-and-drop; it previews the detected format before applying.
milestones.assets: assets/upstream is imported from the upstream checkout into the repository; the manifest records the upstream commit and per-file hashes.

features.title: Dashboard card grid
features.description: Landing dashboard with a searchable, grouped card grid mirroring upstream index.html: icon, title, world badge, description and stable card ids.
acceptance: All 25 upstream dashboard cards are present and grouped exactly like index.html.
Search filters by title, description and world; Escape clears it.
Every card exposes a stable id (card-<section>) and opens its section.

features.title: Section registry and routing
features.description: A single registry declares every section: id, title, group, icon, spec link, status and factory. The shell routes to a section, keeps per-section state alive and restores the last opened section.
acceptance: Adding a section touches one registry entry and one module.
Unknown or disabled sections render a clear empty state, not a panic.
Back navigation and keyboard shortcuts work from every section.

features.title: Shared save JSON import
features.description: One import path for raw decoded saves used by every section, replacing the research-only paste panel. Supports file, paste and drag-and-drop.
acceptance: Raw it.json, save.json and the existing fixture import with the same values as today.
Validation reports the detected format, research level, character count and warnings before applying.
A failed import leaves the current state untouched.

features.title: Project and section JSON import/export
features.description: Export the whole app state as versioned JSON and import it back. Also accept the upstream ROv2 state string and per-section config JSON.
acceptance: Round-trip export then import reproduces every section's visible state.
ROv2 state strings are decompressed and migrated.
Version and section ids are validated; unknown fields warn, not fail.

features.title: Import preview, migration and errors
features.description: A single import pipeline: detect format, parse, migrate to the current schema, show a preview, apply atomically, and keep a warning list.
acceptance: Malformed JSON, wrong format and unsupported versions each get a specific message.
Warnings name the field and the fallback used.
Applying is atomic and logs what changed.

features.title: Upstream asset pipeline
features.description: Script that copies the upstream assets tree from a local checkout into committed assets/upstream, writes a manifest and verifies referenced files. The images are game assets, free to use, not upstream-authored work; the credit lives in assets/upstream/README.md.
acceptance: script/import-upstream-assets.mjs --from <checkout> --dry-run lists every file and total size.
Applying writes assets/upstream plus a manifest with per-file hashes and the upstream commit; the app resolves images through the manifest.
Missing assets render a labelled placeholder, never a broken layout.

features.title: Session persistence and recent imports
features.description: Persist the active section, imported save metadata and section configs across launches in a local app-data file.
acceptance: Relaunch restores the last section and imported state.
Recent imports are listed with time and format.
A corrupt state file is backed up and the app starts clean.

features.title: Shared layout, theme and responsive rules
features.description: Ely-based shell, cards, tabs, tables and form controls shared by all sections; dark palette and spacing match upstream.
acceptance: All sections use the shared page header, tab strip, card and table primitives.
Minimum window size keeps tables scrollable and cards readable.
No section reimplements a component that exists in Ely.

features.title: Empty, loading, error and stale states
features.description: Consistent states for no save, partial save, missing data, long-running work, cancelled work and stale results.
acceptance: Every section renders a helpful no-save state.
Long tasks expose progress and cancel; cancelling restores the previous result.
Stale results are visibly marked after inputs change.

features.title: Per-section verification harness
features.description: Extend the gpui-mcp harness so each section has a smoke path, stable ids and a screenshot baseline.
acceptance: script/mcp-sections.mjs opens every dashboard card and asserts its root node.
Each section has at least one interaction check and one screenshot.
Lane isolation still works when sections run in parallel.

features.title: Shared formula tree and breakdown component
features.description: One expandable formula-tree/breakdown component used by every calculator: nodes show label, input, multiplier, source and result, with search and copy.
acceptance: Every breakdown section renders through the shared component.
Node values and sums match the section totals.

features.title: Background task runner with progress and cancel
features.description: Shared runner for simulations and optimizers: off-thread work, progress reporting, cancellation and a stale-result marker.
acceptance: Long tasks never block the UI thread.
Results are marked stale when their inputs change.

verification: cargo test, clippy and fmt stay clean.
Dashboard opens all 30 sections in the harness.
Import round-trip covers raw save, ROv2 state and project JSON.

milestones.title: Research Optimizer: full upstream parity
milestones.summary: Finish the Research section so all eight upstream tabs and the shared save/supplement tools are present, including the Decision Tree, Insight ROI, Observation Unlocks and full save-derived multipliers.
ui: Tabs: Dashboard, Optimizer, Insight ROI, Observation Unlocks, Shape Optimization, Decision Tree, Minehead, Sushi Station.
Dashboard: summary, research grid, observations, EXP rate breakdown, AFK rate, insight multiplier.
Optimizer: target level/hours, assume observations, extended insight lookahead, tournament +12h, strategy comparison, timeline, EXP/hr chart, step actions and Open in Decision Tree.
Decision Tree: pan/zoom tree, branch/save/delete nodes, upgrade and shape modes, observation editor, auto insight, compare branches.
milestones.assets: Research sprites under assets/combat-sim/ui/research (ResShape*, ResSq*, ResearchBG, magnifier and observation icons).

features.title: Research dashboard tab
features.description: Port the upstream dashboard: summary, research grid preview, observation board, EXP rate breakdown, AFK rate and insight multiplier.
acceptance: All six dashboard blocks render from the loaded save.
Values match the Optimizer tab and the Rust simulation.
Grid and observation previews link to the editors.

features.title: Optimizer target and options
features.description: Target level or hours plus the three upstream toggles: assume observations unlocked, extended insight lookahead and tournament +12h.
acceptance: Each toggle changes the simulated projection in a testable way.
Targets are validated and remembered per session.
The run can be cancelled without losing the previous result.

features.title: Target-aware optimizer engine
features.description: Simulate to the target, spend grid points earned on the way and re-optimize shapes and magnifiers on research and insight level-ups, matching upstream sim-engine and worker-pool behavior.
acceptance: A level target optimizes time-to-level, not only immediate EXP/hr.
Future grid points and observation unlocks are applied at the correct level-ups.
Results are deterministic for the same save and options.

features.title: Strategy comparison, timeline and actions
features.description: Port the upstream result view: best/worst strategy comparison, interactive timeline, EXP/hr chart and expandable step-by-step actions.
acceptance: The comparison reports best and worst tested strategies.
Timeline and chart agree with the projection samples.
Actions expand to their detail and highlight the timeline phase.

features.title: Insight ROI tab
features.description: Per-observation insight levelling analysis: time to level, research EXP lost during the grind, permanent rate gain and break-even time.
acceptance: Table covers every usable observation with the upstream columns.
Values match the simulation's insight formulas.

features.title: Observation Unlocks tab
features.description: Rank undiscovered observations by expected EXP/hr gain weighted by unlock probability per day.
acceptance: Priority table matches upstream ordering for the fixture save.
Missing roll data is reported, not guessed.

features.title: Shape Optimization tab
features.description: Standalone shape workspace: priority tiers above/below the Res EXP divider, drag to reorder, built-in and custom presets, optimized placement preview and coverage breakdown.
acceptance: Tier editing detaches a built-in preset without mutating it.
Custom presets persist in the project state.
Placement preview and breakdown use the real optimizer.

features.title: Decision Tree sandbox
features.description: Interactive tree of research events: branch, save, delete, compare, zoom, level-ups-only, upgrade/shape modes and observation editing.
acceptance: A run can be imported from the Optimizer tab.
Branch comparison shows deltas for rate, level and time.
Auto Insight and shape/magnifier optimize actions work per node.

features.title: Minehead tab
features.description: Port the research page's Minehead tab and its save-derived inputs.
acceptance: All upstream Minehead controls and results are present.
Values update with the loaded save.

features.title: Sushi Station tab

features.title: Full save-derived multiplier tree

acceptance: Imported save rate matches upstream for the fixture and a full-account save.
Every omitted term is warned with its field name.

features.title: State export/import and supplements
features.description: Copy/Paste State string plus the full supplements panel, matching upstream state-io and supplement behavior.
acceptance: Exported ROv2 string imports back to the same state.

Invalid state strings leave the run untouched.

features.title: Grid, shape and magnifier editors
features.description: Complete the manual editing surface: grid levels, shape drag/rotate/add/remove, magnifier assignment, undo/redo and canvas rotation handle.
acceptance: Every edit is undoable and redoable.
Shapes can be rotated on the canvas.

verification: Every research tab opens in the harness.
Formula tests compare against upstream Node fixtures.
Full save fixture matches upstream EXP/hr within tolerance.

trackerIssue.title: Roadmap tracker: implementation order and dependencies
trackerIssue.body: This issue tracks the whole implementation. Every section has a milestone; every feature has an issue with its dependencies, upstream sources, acceptance criteria and verification. Start at M0, then follow the dependency links on each issue.
